सिंगल रहने वालों के लिए आ रही है बड़ी खबर, क्योंकि बालाजी टेलीफिल्म्स ला रहा है एक मसालेदार मैचमेकिंग शो! 🔥

टीवी की मशहूर एक्ट्रेस उर्वशी ढोलकिया इस नए शो It's A Meal को होस्ट करने जा रही हैं। 📺

इस डिजिटल शो में मन्नारा चोपड़ा, नाइरा एम बनर्जी, अमन गांधी और आकांक्षा चमोला जैसे जाने-पहचाने चेहरे अपने लिए कनेक्शन तलाशते दिखेंगे।

यह शो 19 December को बालाजी टेलीफिल्म्स के ऑफिशियल YouTube चैनल पर प्रीमियर होने के लिए पूरी तरह तैयार है। 🎬

शो में हिस्सा ले रहीं आकांक्षा चमोला ने बताया कि वह अपने कम्फर्ट ज़ोन से बाहर निकलकर कनेक्शन तलाशने के लिए एक्साइटेड हैं। वहीं नाइरा एम बनर्जी के मुताबिक, अलग-अलग बैकग्राउंड के लोगों से मिलना काफी चैलेंजिंग और सरप्राइजिंग होगा।

बालाजी टेलीफिल्म्स के ग्रुप CEO संजय द्विवेदी और हूनर के टैलेंट हेड मोहम्मद नगमान लतीफ का कहना है कि यह शो बदलते डिजिटल दौर में लव और रिलेशनशिप को एक नया पर्सपेक्टिव देगा।

क्या आप उर्वशी ढोलकिया के इस नए शो It's A Meal को देखने के लिए एक्साइटेड हैं? कमेंट्स में अपनी राय ज़रूर बताएं! 👇

ctx.text:
Balaji Telefilms is set to explore the matchmaking format with its upcoming digital show It's A Meal, which will premiere on December 19 on the production house's official YouTube channel. Hosted by television actor Urvashi Dholakia, the show will feature familiar faces from the television industry, including Mannara Chopra, Nyrraa M Banerji, Aman Gandhi and Akanksha Chamola.
The show will bring together singles from different backgrounds and personalities as they interact and explore the possibility of finding a romantic connection. Created by Adhiksha Gupta and Mohammed Nagaman Lateef, the format will focus on conversations, relationships and the dynamics that emerge when people meet for the first time.
Akanksha Chamola, who is among the participants, spoke about stepping outside her comfort zone through the show. Sharing her thoughts, she said, “This show is sure to get people out of their comfort zones to find their favourite person. I believe every person has a different story, and sometimes all it takes is one conversation to discover a connection. I'm looking forward to the fun, the surprises and everything this experience has in store.”
Nyrraa M Banerji also shared her expectations from the experience. “Love, chemistry and relationships, these are always interesting because everyone has a different way of looking at them. What I find exciting about this show is that I'll get to meet people coming from different walks of life and see how things go with them. It's going to be challenging at times for sure but also very surprising,” she said.
Commenting on the launch, Sanjay Dwivedi, Group CEO and Group CFO of Balaji Telefilms, said the company is looking to explore new formats as digital viewing habits evolve. “At Balaji Telefilms, our focus has always been on identifying evolving audience preferences and translating them into engaging entertainment experiences. As the digital entertainment landscape continues to grow, we see immense opportunities to experiment with fresh concepts, distinctive formats and stories that resonate with audiences across platforms. With It's A Meal, we are bringing an interesting take on relationships and matchmaking, packaged in an entertaining format,” he said.
Mohammed Nagaman Lateef, Head of Talent at Balaji Telefilms' talent division Hoonur, also spoke about the idea behind the show. “The idea behind It's A Meal was to of course to make the journey of finding a connection entertaining and engaging. Relationships and matchmaking are subjects that naturally spark curiosity, conversations and emotions, and we wanted to explore this with a fresh, contemporary perspective,” he said.
It's A Meal will premiere on December 19, exclusively on the Balaji Telefilms YouTube channel.
